editorial.tldr: Mid-October arXiv papers extended multimodal LLMs with tool use and reasoning-driven embeddings. Late October work turned to when models should refuse and how vision and language modules exchange information.
editorial.whats_new: VIGOR, an arXiv preprint, orders token unmasking by visual gain to reduce hallucination in multimodal discrete diffusion language models.
editorial.why_it_matters: Multimodal failures, such as answering without enough visual evidence or losing perception under small perturbations, are reliability issues for any pipeline that feeds images to a model.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you ship vision inputs, add an insufficient-evidence refusal case and a perturbed-image case to your evals; these preprints are unreplicated, so verify on your own data.
